Stack, rotate, and clear bricks in full 3D — built from the ground up for Meta Quest.
No flat screens. No mouse clicks. Just you, your controllers, and a floating grid of falling bricks that you rotate, drop, and clear in real 3D space. It's the puzzle game you already know, made tactile for the first time.
WHY PLAYERS PICK THIS ONE:
🧱 100+ Handcrafted Levels — From easy warm-ups to genuinely hard, precision-timing challenges. No filler, no repeats.
🎮 Two Ways to Play — Classic Mode for relaxed, no-timer puzzle solving, and Challenge Mode for speed-scoring and leaderboard chasing.
🕹️ Precision Controller Support — Grab, rotate, and place bricks with responsive Touch controller input designed for natural, comfortable play.
🌌 Immersive 3D Environments — Deep space, cozy workshop, neon arcade. The same puzzle never looks the same twice.
🪑 Seated or Standing Play — Comfort-first camera, no forced locomotion, perfect for short sessions or long ones.
📊 Global Leaderboards — Compare your best clears and speedruns against players worldwide.
🚫 No Ads, No Pay-to-Win — One purchase, the full game. Every level, every mode, every theme.
Whether you've got 5 minutes or 50, Brick Block Puzzle VR turns the most addictive puzzle format ever made into something you can reach out and touch.
